lines.text: Go home, not go to home!
Many learners say: I am going to home now.
Better: I am going home now.
The second! Let's go home now.

data.wrong: I am going to home now.

native.tip: Türkçede “eve gidiyorum” deriz, “-e” eki “to” gibi durur; İngilizcede “home” önüne “to” gelmez: “I am going home now.”
native.caption: “I am going to home now” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “go” sonrası “home” tek başına gelir, “to” kullanılmaz. Doğrusu “I am going home now.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “home”. “Go” sonrası “home” tek başına gelir. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Do not use “to” before “home”: “I am going home now.”
en.caption: Do you say “I am going to home now”? 😅 In English “home” comes right after “go” with no “to” in between. The right sentence is “I am going home now.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
